items.exampleEn: Our teacher started the class with a short greeting.
items.exampleZh: 老師用簡短的問候開始上課。

items.exampleEn: My nephew just started his first year of school.
items.exampleZh: 我外甥剛開始上小學一年級。

items.exampleEn: Online dating has become very common.
items.exampleZh: 網路交友約會已經變得很普遍。

items.exampleEn: He wore a respectable suit to the interview.
items.exampleZh: 他穿了一套體面的西裝去面試。

items.exampleEn: My niece wants to be a doctor when she grows up.
items.exampleZh: 我姪女長大後想當醫生。

items.exampleEn: The newborn baby slept all afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 新生寶寶睡了一整個下午。

items.exampleEn: My uncle has been divorced for five years.
Many couples save money for a special honeymoon.
items.exampleZh: 很多新人會存錢，好去一趟特別的蜜月旅行。

items.sentenceEn: My sister just had a newborn son, so I'm an uncle now.
items.sentenceZh: 我姊姊剛生了一個兒子，所以我現在當舅舅了。

items.audioEn: My niece and nephew are coming to stay with us this weekend.
items.audioZh: 我的姪女和姪子這個週末要來我們家住。
options: The speaker's niece and her friend.
Two friends from the speaker's work.
The speaker's nephew and his dog.
The children of the speaker's sister or brother.

items.sentenceEn: Shaking hands is a common greeting in many places.
items.sentenceZh: 握手在很多地方是常見的打招呼方式。

items.sentenceEn: My grandparents still talk about their honeymoon fifty years ago.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺奶奶到現在還會聊起五十年前的蜜月。

items.stemEn: He found a ____ job at a bank, and his parents were very proud.
items.stemZh: 他在銀行找到一份體面的工作，父母非常驕傲。

items.stemEn: After the wedding, the couple flew to Japan for their ____.
items.stemZh: 婚禮後，這對新人飛到日本度蜜月。

items.passageEn: My cousin Linda got married last spring. Her parents are divorced, but both of them came to the wedding and sat at the same table. Linda met her husband through online dating three years ago. He is a quiet, respectable man who currently teaches music. My little niece and nephew carried the flowers. After the party, guests wrote warm greetings in a book. The couple spent their honeymoon in Japan. Now Linda is busy buying clothes for a newborn baby: her own!
items.passageZh: 我表姊 Linda 去年春天結婚了。她的父母離婚了，但兩人都來參加婚禮，還坐在同一桌。Linda 三年前透過網路交友認識她先生。他是一位安靜又體面的人，目前在教音樂。我的小姪女和小姪子負責拿花。派對結束後，客人在本子上寫下溫暖的祝福。這對新人去日本度蜜月。現在 Linda 正忙著為一個新生兒買衣服——她自己的寶寶！

questions.questionZh: Linda 和先生是怎麼認識的？

items.promptZh: 他們去度蜜月了，下週回來。
referenceEn: They are on their honeymoon and will be back next week.
They went on their honeymoon and will come back next week.
rubricZh: 「度蜜月」可寫 be on their honeymoon、go on their honeymoon 等
「下週回來」用表示未來的寫法（例如 will be back、will come back）

items.instructionZh: 用 greeting 造一個句子，說說你平常怎麼和人打招呼或送祝福。
referenceEn: I usually send holiday greetings to my friends by message.
My favorite greeting is a big smile.
rubricZh: greeting 表示「問候、祝福」，是可數名詞（例如 send greetings）
說的是自己的習慣（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
